name: SCADA Intrusion Threatens Grid Operations
description: An attacker pivots from IT into the SCADA environment controlling substations and distribution automation, forcing manual grid operations during eviction.
effect: Manual grid operations and outage risk
assumptions: Load keeps flowing under manual operations; the loss is response, not blackout damages.
Primary loss covers OT forensics, manual staffing, and segmented rebuild.
Secondary loss covers NERC/state reporting, member trust, and insurance repricing.

name: Ransomware Hits Member Billing Systems
description: Ransomware encrypts member billing, outage management, and the member portal; crews work from radios and printed maps while IT rebuilds.
asset: Billing, outage management, and member portal
assumptions: Power delivery is unaffected; the loss is administrative downtime and delayed cash flow.
Cooperative policy prohibits ransom payment; recovery is from backups.
Secondary loss covers member complaints, board scrutiny, and state filings.

name: AMI Metering Network Tampering
description: Attackers exploit the advanced metering infrastructure head-end to falsify reads or issue disconnects, corrupting billing data across the service territory.
asset: AMI head-end and meter data management
assumptions: Mass remote disconnect is rate-limited by design; the modeled loss is data integrity.
Primary loss covers re-reads, billing corrections, and head-end rebuild.
Secondary loss covers member reimbursement claims and regulatory attention.

name: Construction Project Payment Fraud
description: Fraudsters impersonate line-construction and substation contractors to redirect large progress payments on capital projects.
assumptions: Progress-payment schedules on public capital projects are visible and predictable.
Primary loss is the unrecovered payment after bank and insurance recovery.
Secondary loss covers project delay costs and co-op board governance fallout.

name: Member Data Breach
description: An intrusion exposes member account data — names, addresses, usage histories, and bank details for autopay members.
asset: Member PII and payment enrollment data
assumptions: Autopay bank details drive notification duties beyond basic PII.
Primary loss covers forensics, notification, and credit monitoring for members.
Secondary loss covers member attrition where competitive choice exists, and litigation.
